method: Latest 60000 position changes (last 9.3 hours). A new position counts as protected when a stop order on the same account and market was created between 60 seconds before and 10 minutes after it opened. Accounts with at most 6 position changes and less than 1 USDso of realized PnL in the window are treated as automated and excluded. Liquidation fees are summed over the last 7 days.
